name: create-riot-app
description: Riot.js application starter. Scaffolds a Bun server (Hono, server-rendered pages, and a client cabinet) or a client-only Vite app.

scripts.demo:build: bun run --cwd templates/fullstack build && bun run --cwd templates/spa build
scripts.demo:typecheck: bun run --cwd templates/fullstack typecheck && bun run --cwd templates/spa typecheck
scripts.lint: biome check bin && bun run --cwd templates/spa lint && bun run --cwd templates/fullstack lint
scripts.lint:fix: biome check --write bin && bun run --cwd templates/spa lint:fix && bun run --cwd templates/fullstack lint:fix
scripts.format: biome format --write bin && bun run --cwd templates/spa format && bun run --cwd templates/fullstack format
scripts.format:check: biome format bin && bun run --cwd templates/spa format:check && bun run --cwd templates/fullstack format:check
